cohort: Women with FXI levels between 20% and 70% of normal (cases) and 200 women without known bleeding disorders (controls)
finding: Mild FXI deficiency was associated with an increased risk of PPH following caesarean delivery but not vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The rate of PPH was significantly higher among caesarean deliveries in women with mild FXI deficiency compared to controls, while there was no difference in PPH rates between women with mild FXI deficiency and controls following vaginal delivery.
